item.title: Saturday Morning Run
item.description:
Oct 10, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 3.14 km
  • Duration: 22m 3s
  • Pace: 7:01 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 140 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

SUMMARY This is the first workout from Garmin 165 watch after my struggle with Apple watch as its sensor had some issues from almost two month now. Repairing would have costed more than half of the new Garmin watch price. Now I am very happy about my decision. The weather is a bit chilly after yesterday’s whole day rain, but quit suitable for workout after warming up.

Feeling peaceful after the run.

item.title: Afternoon Run
item.description:
Sep 26, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 3.03 km
  • Duration: 20m 8s
  • Pace: 6:39 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 162 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

After finishing this run my lungs were happy despite of pushing through another kilometer than I usually go. However, for my legs it was a different story. My muscles were a bit overdoing, indicating that the strength is not there. So I need to figure out how to improve it. Nevertheless, I am feeling good about the run. It was easy and fun.

item.description:

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 2.10 km
  • Duration: 14m 7s
  • Pace: 6:43 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 150 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

It’s not usual for me to go for Monday run instead I try to go on Sundays and take a break on Monday. But now I have energy to do it so I went after work.

Everything was smooth, a bit warmer temperature and I was doing fine. However, I am recently observing that Apple Watch has some issue with heart rate sensor.

This is not nice but I am not gonna put more money in their bullshit business. I also don't want to spend money.

item.title: Saturday Run
item.description:
Sep 12, 2026

  • Type: Running
  • Distance: 3.03 km
  • Duration: 19m 47s
  • Pace: 6:32 min/km
  • Average heart rate: 158 bpm
  • Source: CSV

Summary

Oh Man, it was an amazing run. Practicing relaxing runs seemed to build some strength in my body. So first two kilometers went usually. But as it's weekend, I thought to try the third one but with higher speed. I nailed it and I was not exhausted in the end. Instead, I was enjoying the music and run all along.
